takeaways.en: Append stacks tables on top of each other (more rows); Merge joins them side by side on matching keys (more columns).
takeaways.zh: 「追加」把表上下叠起来（行变多）；「合并」按匹配的键左右连接（列变多）。

takeaways.en: Merge offers six join kinds: left outer, right outer, full outer, inner, left anti and right anti.
takeaways.zh: 「合并」提供六种联接类型：左外部、右外部、完全外部、内部、左反和右反。

takeaways.en: Left anti returns rows from the first table that have no match — the quick way to find orphans.
takeaways.zh: 左反联接返回第一张表中没有匹配的行——这是找出孤立记录最快的方法。

html.en: Combining queries is one of the most tested Power Query skills. The two words sound alike but do opposite things.
html.zh: 合并多个查询是 Power Query 最常考的技能之一。两个词听起来相似，作用却完全不同。

rows.en: Vertical: rows of table B under table A
rows.zh: 垂直：表 B 的行接在表 A 下方

rows.en: Horizontal: columns of B added to A by matching key
rows.zh: 水平：按匹配的键，把 B 的列加到 A

rows.en: Sales2025 + Sales2026; one table per region
Bring Category from Product into Sales; look up a code
rows.zh: 把 Product 的 Category 带进 Sales；查对照代码

rows.en: Matched by name; a column missing in one table is filled with null
rows.zh: 按名称对应；某张表缺少的列会以 null 填充

rows.en: You pick the key column(s) in each table
rows.zh: 你在两张表中各自选择键列

rows.en: All rows of the first table, matching rows of the second
rows.zh: 第一张表的所有行，加上第二张表中匹配的行

rows.en: All rows of the second table, matching rows of the first
rows.zh: 第二张表的所有行，加上第一张表中匹配的行

rows.en: Only rows that match in both
rows.zh: 只有两张表都匹配的行

rows.en: Rows of the first table with no match
rows.zh: 第一张表中没有匹配的行

rows.en: Rows of the second table with no match
rows.zh: 第二张表中没有匹配的行

html.en: Merge also supports fuzzy matching for keys that are spelled slightly differently, with a similarity threshold you can tune. Use Append Queries as New or Merge Queries as New to keep the original queries unchanged.
html.zh: 「合并」还支持模糊匹配，用于拼写稍有不同的键，相似度阈值可以调整。使用将查询追加为新查询或将查询合并为新查询，可以保留原本的查询不变。

q.en: You need a list of customers who have never placed an order. Which merge from Customers to Orders gives it directly?
q.zh: 你需要一份从未下过订单的客户名单。从 Customers 合并到 Orders，用哪种联接能直接得到？

why.en: Returns all customers; you would still have to filter for nulls.
why.zh: 会返回所有客户，还要再筛选 null。

why.en: Inner returns customers who did order.
why.zh: 内部联接返回的是下过订单的客户。

why.en: Right: customers with no matching order.
why.zh: 对：没有匹配订单的客户。

q.en: Sales for 2025 and 2026 are in two queries with the same columns. You need one Sales table. What do you do?
q.zh: 2025 年和 2026 年的销售数据在两个列相同的查询中。你需要一张 Sales 表，该怎么做？

why.en: Right: append stacks rows of tables that share columns.
why.zh: 对：追加会把列相同的表的行叠在一起。
合并增加的是列，不是行。

heading.zh: 引用查询还是复制查询

takeaways.en: Duplicate copies all of a query's steps into an independent new query.
takeaways.zh: 「复制」会把查询的所有步骤复制成一个独立的新查询。

takeaways.en: Reference starts a new query from the output of an existing one, so changes to the original flow through.
takeaways.zh: 「引用」以现有查询的输出作为新查询的起点，所以原查询的修改会一路传下去。

takeaways.en: A common pattern: one staging query (load disabled) referenced by several fact and dimension queries.
takeaways.zh: 常见模式：一个暂存查询（停用加载），被多个事实表和维度表查询引用。

rows.en: You want to experiment or need a variant that must not change
rows.zh: 想试验，或需要一个不能被影响的变体

rows.en: Several tables come from the same cleaned source
rows.zh: 多张表来自同一个已清理的来源

html.en: Example: a flat Sales export holds order lines with product and customer details repeated on every row. Load it once as SalesStaging, clean it, and disable its load. Then Reference it three times: keep the product columns and remove duplicates → Product; the customer columns → Customer; the keys and numbers → Sales.
html.zh: 例子：某个扁平的销售导出文件包含订单明细，每一行都重复着产品和客户资料。先把它载入为 SalesStaging、清理好并停用加载。然后引用它三次：保留产品列并删除重复项 → Product；客户列 → Customer；键和数值 → Sales。

html.en: Referencing does not cache the original's result: each query that references it is evaluated on its own, so the source can be read more than once during refresh. That is usually fine, but for a slow source consider a dataflow.
html.zh: 引用并不会缓存原查询的结果：每个引用它的查询都会各自计算，所以刷新时数据源可能被读取不止一次。通常没问题，但如果数据源很慢，可以考虑使用数据流。

q.en: Product and Customer dimensions must both come from the same cleaned staging query, and future cleaning steps must apply to both. What do you use?
q.zh: Product 和 Customer 维度表都必须来自同一个已清理的暂存查询，而且之后新增的清理步骤要同时套用到两者。该用什么？

why.en: Right: changes to the staging query flow into both references.
why.zh: 对：对暂存查询的修改会传到两个引用查询。

html.en: Append the staging query to itself
html.zh: 把暂存查询追加到自身

why.en: Duplicates are independent; you would repeat every future step.
why.zh: 副本是独立的；以后每个步骤都得重复做。

html.zh: 用 DAX 建立计算表

why.en: Possible, but cleaning belongs in Power Query and the question asks for shared steps.
why.zh: 可行，但清理应该在 Power Query 中进行，而题目要求共享步骤。

heading.en: Fact tables, dimension tables and keys

takeaways.en: Fact tables hold events and numbers (sales lines, transactions); dimension tables describe them (product, customer, date).
takeaways.zh: 事实表存放事件和数值（销售明细、交易）；维度表负责描述它们（产品、客户、日期）。

takeaways.en: Each dimension needs a key with one row per value; the fact table holds that key as a foreign key.
takeaways.zh: 每张维度表都需要一个键，每个值只有一行；事实表把这个键当作外键保存。

takeaways.en: Power BI relationships use a single column: create a surrogate key (Index) or merge columns when the natural key spans several columns.
takeaways.zh: Power BI 的关系只能用单一列：当自然键横跨多列时，要建立代理键（索引列）或合并列。

html.en: Power Query is where you decide the shape of the model. The target is a star schema (covered in Course 3): narrow fact tables in the middle, descriptive dimension tables around them.
html.zh: Power Query 是决定模型形状的地方。目标是星型架构（课程 3 会讲）：中间是窄的事实表，周围是描述性的维度表。

rows.en: Events: one row per sale, visit, transaction
rows.zh: 事件：每笔销售、每次访问、每笔交易一行

rows.en: Things: one row per product, customer, date
rows.zh: 事物：每个产品、客户、日期一行

rows.en: Keys to dimensions + numeric values to aggregate
rows.zh: 指向维度表的键 + 要汇总的数值

rows.en: A key + descriptive attributes (name, category, city)
rows.zh: 一个键 + 描述性属性（名称、类别、城市）

items.en: Natural key: an ID from the source, such as ProductCode.
items.zh: 自然键：来自源系统的标识，例如 ProductCode。

items.en: Surrogate key: a new whole-number ID you add (Index column), useful when the natural key is long text or missing.
items.zh: 代理键：你新增的整数标识（索引列），适合自然键是很长的文字或缺失时使用。

items.en: Composite key: when uniqueness needs two columns (StoreID + ProductID), merge them into one key column in both tables — a relationship can use only one column.
items.zh: 组合键：当需要两列才能唯一（StoreID + ProductID）时，在两张表中都把它们合并成一个键列——关系只能使用一列。

items.en: Integer keys compress better than text keys and make relationships faster.
items.zh: 整数键比文字键压缩得更好，关系也更快。

html.en: When a question says a relationship cannot be created because the key is made of two columns, the answer is to add a merged (concatenated) key column in both tables, or a surrogate key.
html.zh: 当题目说因为键由两列组成而无法建立关系时，答案是在两张表中都新增一个合并（串接）的键列，或使用代理键。

q.en: Stock levels are unique per Store and Product. You must relate Stock to a StoreProduct table. What do you do?
q.zh: 库存数据在「门店 + 产品」上才唯一。你必须把 Stock 关联到 StoreProduct 表，该怎么做？

html.en: Create two relationships, one per column
html.zh: 建立两个关系，每列一个

why.en: Only one of them could be active, and neither is unique alone.
why.zh: 只有其中一个能是活动的，而且单独一列都不唯一。

html.en: Merge StoreID and ProductID into one key column in both tables
html.zh: 在两张表中把 StoreID 和 ProductID 合并成一个键列

why.en: Right: relationships use a single column.
why.zh: 对：关系只能使用单一列。

html.en: Use a many-to-many relationship on StoreID
html.zh: 以 StoreID 建立多对多关系

why.en: That gives wrong totals per product.
why.zh: 这样按产品的合计会出错。

takeaways.en: Query folding turns Power Query steps into one source query (for example SQL), so the source does the work.
takeaways.zh: 查询折叠把 Power Query 步骤转换成一个源查询（例如 SQL），让数据源来完成工作。

takeaways.en: Right-click a step: if View Native Query is available, the step folds. Put folding steps first.
takeaways.zh: 右键单击步骤：如果能使用「查看本机查询」，表示该步骤可以折叠。把能折叠的步骤放在前面。

takeaways.en: Untick Enable load for staging and helper queries so they are not added to the model.
takeaways.zh: 对暂存和辅助查询取消勾选「启用加载」，这样它们就不会加入模型。

html.en: When the source is a database, Power Query tries to translate your steps — filter rows, remove columns, group by, merge — into a single native query. The database then returns only the rows and columns you need. This is query folding, and it makes refresh much faster. It is also required for incremental refresh and for DirectQuery.
html.zh: 当数据源是数据库时，Power Query 会尝试把你的步骤——筛选行、删除列、分组、合并——翻译成一个本机查询。数据库就只返回你需要的行和列。这就是查询折叠，它能让刷新快很多。增量刷新和 DirectQuery 也都需要它。

items.en: Steps that usually fold: filter, remove/select columns, rename, group by, merge and append on the same source, simple type changes.
items.zh: 通常可以折叠的步骤：筛选、删除/选择列、重命名、分组、同一来源上的合并与追加、简单的类型更改。

items.en: Steps that often break folding: adding an Index column, custom M functions, merging with a different source, some text transformations.
items.zh: 经常会打断折叠的步骤：新增索引列、自定义 M 函数、与不同来源合并、部分文字转换。

items.en: Once a step does not fold, the steps after it do not fold either — so order matters.
items.zh: 一旦某个步骤不能折叠，它后面的步骤也都不能折叠——所以顺序很重要。

rows.en: The query becomes a table in the model.
rows.zh: 查询成为模型中的一张表。

rows.en: The query exists only to feed others; shown in italics. Saves memory.
rows.zh: 查询只用来供应其他查询；名称以斜体显示。可节省内存。

rows.en: Untick for static tables you never want to refresh.
rows.zh: 对永远不想刷新的静态表取消勾选。

q.en: Which query should have Enable load turned off?
q.zh: 哪个查询应该关闭「启用加载」？

html.en: A table used in an RLS role
html.zh: 在 RLS 角色中使用的表

html.en: A staging query that other queries reference
html.zh: 被其他查询引用的暂存查询

why.en: Right: its data reaches the model through the queries that reference it.
why.zh: 对：它的数据会经由引用它的查询进入模型。

q.en: A query against SQL Server refreshes slowly. Steps: Source → Add Index Column → Filtered Rows (last 2 years) → Removed Columns. What change helps most?
q.zh: 某个针对 SQL Server 的查询刷新很慢。步骤：源 → 添加索引列 → 筛选的行（最近 2 年）→ 删除的列。哪个修改最有帮助？

html.en: Change the privacy level to Public
Move the filter and column removal before the index step
html.zh: 把筛选和删除列移到索引步骤之前

why.en: Right: adding an index breaks folding, so the filter ran in Power Query on all rows.
why.zh: 对：新增索引会打断折叠，所以筛选是在 Power Query 中对所有行执行的。

why.en: Then the table would not reach the model at all.
why.zh: 那样这张表就根本进不了模型。

why.en: Profiling affects the editor preview, not refresh.
why.zh: 列分析只影响编辑器预览，不影响刷新。
